g.text: ONE PROBLEM. MULTIPLE WAYS. SCORE YOUR MASTERY.

text.tspan: Real mathematical confidence comes from seeing that the
same answer appears whether you use physical blocks,
1 Block = +10 (1st Way) • 2 Blocks = +20 (2nd Way)
mental math, or the SC-6 RPN stack! Stacking a second +10
token physically rewards trying a second approach.
Pop off the 3x1 Snapfinity lid to reveal the open storage bin
holding all 60 tokens. Use the lid's 12 sockets (1–10, 100, and
Question Mark in a Circle ? badge) for daily 10-question practice!

g.text: TOTAL: 60 Universal +10 Score Tokens + 7U Storage Bin + Scoreboard Lid = 62 Parts

text.tspan: Classroom manipulatives get lost. Never abandon
an incomplete set! Every individual math component
is permanently stocked for single replacements.

g.text: Scan back QR or visit stackcalc.io/parts

text.tspan: No inner sorting tray needed! Sweep all 60 universal +10
tokens directly into the open 3x1x7U Gridfinity bin, lay
this reference card on top, and snap the Scoreboard Lid
shut for silent, zero-rattle classroom storage.
Flip this card over for a complete step-by-step
hands-on lesson with concrete numbers, stage
arrangements, calculator cross-references, and
core mathematical principle breakthrough!
Keep this card stored inside the box lid!

g.text: Designed in Mountain View, California, USA • Non-Toxic BPA-Free.
Solving one problem in two independent ways builds deeper mastery than solving ten by rote.
Modular Hardware Continuum (9 Kits) • Universal 7.00mm Datum • SIDE A: IN-BOX USER COMPANION GUIDE | OFFICE LASER PAPER SPEC
